rationale: The startup account's central claim is that a real cluster prefix whose snapshot leaves 129 replay batches blocks inside NewRaft while the same prefix at 128 batches returns. That pair rests on one run, receipt 5298e93f6b814e72be0a4b16cfb10633, and the account says the boundary follows the batch count rather than replay volume because the two cases differ by a single committed entry. Repeating the same fixed experiment from its retained inputs re-runs the three prefixes, so the pair can be confirmed or shown to depend on that run's scheduling, and the twenty-second window on the blocked case is exercised a second time.
